purpose: Measures layer-dissolving currency not explained by native probes.

data.L0: native probe family restricted to E0
data.D0: layer-dissolving probe family restricted to E0

exact_adequacy: Xi=0 iff D0 factors through L0 iff ker(L0) subset ker(D0).
promotion_rule: K_LL<=Theta_Y and Xi<=Xi_Z imply K_DD<=A_star Theta_Y A_star^* + Xi_Z.
extension_rule: Adding native probes L+=[L;M] gives Xi(D|L+) <= Xi(D|L).
nonclaims: No claim for raw substrates or undeclared dissolving probes.
No layer-dissolving membrane from native membrane without adequacy.
No use of pseudoinverse formula without null-mode legality.
